rules.text: You can return petco.com orders to a store within 30 days of shipment for a full refund.
rules.quote: Your local Petco or Unleashed by Petco store will gladly accept the return of your petco.com order within 30 days of the initial shipment date for a full refund.

rules.text: Returns made 31-60 days after shipment receive a full refund as merchandise credit.
rules.quote: Returns made 31-60 days after shipment will receive a full refund as merchandise credit.

rules.text: Prescription medicine and pharmacy products are not eligible for returns in-store or by mail.
rules.quote: Restrictions on returns: Prescription medicine and pharmacy products are not eligible for returns in-store or by mail.

rules.text: Valid government issued ID is required for all returns and exchanges in store.
rules.quote: Valid government issued identification is required for all returns and exchanges.

rules.text: Returns without a receipt or made after 60 days are not eligible for return or exchange.
rules.quote: Returns without a receipt or made after 60 days are not eligible for return or exchange.

rules.text: Return shipping fees will be deducted from the refund when shipping items back.
rules.quote: Return shipping fees will be deducted from the refund

rules.text: Refunds take about 10 days to process to your original payment method after the item is received.
rules.quote: It takes about 10 days to process the refund to your original payment method.

rules.text: Refunds for online orders are issued to the original form of payment or merchandise credit depending on timing.
rules.quote: Items received within 30 days will receive a full refund to the original form of tender. Items received within 31-60 days will receive a full refund as merchandise credit.

rules.text: Saltwater aquatic life cannot be returned or exchanged in store.
rules.quote: Saltwater aquatic life cannot be returned or exchanged.

rules.text: Prescription medication items cannot be returned to a store.
rules.quote: Personalized items or prescription medication items cannot be returned to a store.

rules.text: Freshwater aquatic life purchased in store is guaranteed for 30 days for an exchange or full refund with receipt.
rules.quote: In a properly established habitat, Petco guarantees freshwater aquatic life for 30 days from the date of purchase for an exchange or full refund to original form of payment. A receipt is required, and a water sample is recommended for all refunds and exchanges.
